findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.citation_text:
3-202.15  (Pf) Can of soup (Progresso) is dented and in poor condition. Food packaging must be in good condition so that foods are not exposed to adulteration or potential contamination. Reference 3-202.15.

Observed soup cans with denting along rim. Spoke to PIC about acceptable/unacceptable canned goods. Any cans with denting on either top/bottom rims or large, sharp dents on body of can should be rejected/set aside upon delivery to facility and refunded by vendor. PIC removed cans from shelves.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed 2 urinals in men's restroom that need to be caulked to the wall. This will make the surface smooth and easily cleanable.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed shelves and containers (cans and bottles) to have accumulation of dust. Clean these items and maintain dust-free.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed leak at hot water valve at mop sink. Fix this leak.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: [1] The following floors are in disrepair:  (A) coving along right-hand side wall (when entering) of men's restroom (pulling away from wall), (B) coving in diaper change station stall of women's restroom (grout missing at floor-to-wall junction).  Repair these floors.  [2] Floor in mop room is wet/has standing water.  Clean & dry this floor.  Due to design of how mops are to be hung to dry, water will likely drip on floor often.  Try to keep floor clean and dry as much as possible (and make sure mops are wrung dry before hanging).               750-1200 The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.                750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.
